original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs Docker (apt or yum source), adds a specified user to the docker group, and ensures the docker daemon is running and enabled at boot.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs Docker (apt or yum source), adds a specified user to the docker group, and ensures the docker daemon is running and enabled at boot.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Install and configure Docker
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: yes

  vars:
    target_docker_user: "{{ docker_user | default(ansible_user_id) }}"
    docker_debian_remove:
      - docker
      - docker-engine
      - docker.io
      - containerd
      - runc
    docker_redhat_remove:
      - docker
      - docker-client
      - docker-client-latest
      - docker-common
      - docker-latest
      - docker-latest-logrotate
      - docker-logrotate
      - docker-engine
    docker_packages_common:
      - docker-ce
      - docker-ce-cli
      - containerd.io
      - docker-buildx-plugin
      - docker-compose-plugin

  tasks:
    - name: Detect APT-based systems
      set_fact:
        docker_apt_repo_os: "{{ 'ubuntu' if ansible_distribution | lower == 'ubuntu' else 'debian' }}"
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Remove old Docker packages (Debian family)
      apt:
        name: "{{ docker_debian_remove }}"
        state: absent
        purge: yes
        autoremove: yes
        update_cache: yes
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Install prerequisites (Debian family)
      apt:
        name:
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
          - gnupg
          - lsb-release
        state: present
        update_cache: yes
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Create directory for APT keyrings
      file:
        path: /etc/apt/keyrings
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Download Docker GPG key (ASCII) for APT
      get_url:
        url: "https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ docker_apt_repo_os }}/gpg"
        dest: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
        mode: '0644'
        force: yes
        validate_certs: yes
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Convert Docker GPG key to keyring format
      command: gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
      args:
        creates: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Ensure keyring has secure permissions
      file:
        path: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
        mode: '0644'
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Add Docker APT repository
      apt_repository:
        repo: "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ docker_apt_repo_os }} {{ ansible_distribution_release | lower }} stable"
        filename: docker
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Update APT cache
      apt:
        update_cache: yes
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Remove old Docker packages (RedHat family)
      yum:
        name: "{{ docker_redhat_remove }}"
        state: absent
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Install prerequisites (RedHat family)
      yum:
        name:
          - yum-utils
          - device-mapper-persistent-data
          - lvm2
          - ca-certificates
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Add Docker YUM repository
      yum_repository:
        name: docker-ce-stable
        description: Docker CE Stable - $basearch
        baseurl: "https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/$releasever/$basearch/stable"
        enabled: yes
        gpgcheck: yes
        gpgkey: https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/gpg
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Refresh package metadata (RedHat family)
      yum:
        update_cache: yes
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Install Docker packages (Debian family)
      apt:
        name: "{{ docker_packages_common }}"
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Install Docker packages (RedHat family)
      yum:
        name: "{{ docker_packages_common }}"
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Ensure docker group exists
      group:
        name: docker
        state: present

    - name: Add user to docker group
      user:
        name: "{{ target_docker_user }}"
        groups: docker
        append: yes

    - name: Reset SSH connection to apply new group membership
      meta: reset_connection

    - name: Enable and start Docker service
      service:
        name: docker
        enabled: yes
        state: started
